watches.name: Alpine Automatic Dark Side
watches.description: Forged for the Few Only 24 Available of 25 produced A New Path in the Ad Mare Legacy Walking on the "Dark Side” Limited Run Born from the same spirit that guides the Whitby Alpine line — bridging sea to sky, cliff to compass — the Dark Side Alpine stakes its claim in shadow. This is not merely a blacked-out version of what came before: it is a watch recast for the bold, a nocturnal companion forged for adventure when light fades. Like the original Alpine designs, it channels the rugged geometry of mountain passes and the flow of wild terrain, where curves meet sharp facets. In the Dark Side, those surfaces speak in muted tones, textured depth, and moody contrast. A new chapter in the Alpine saga: a fully automatic movement powering a watch wrapped in silence and shadow. The “snow-drift” dial dances in low light, revealing texture only when the eye lingers. With a 44 mm black-coated case, 200 m water resistance, sapphire crystal, and carefully faceted surfaces, this watch is built both to endure and to intrigue. Only 25 have been made with 24 available to our VIPs. Walk on the Dark Side. watches.name: Intrepid X | Chrono-Diver | Black
watches.description: X represents the faceless sacrifice and commitment of countless Special Operations Executive agents. The X keeps the light in the darkness alive by honouring those who can only be identified as X … This is Intrepid X Proudly Designed and Assembled in Canada The foundations for intelligence operations built by true Spy Master Sir William Stephenson (Codename Intrepid) and Camp X in Whitby Ontario, was a small piece of an international effort to swing victory in WWII. Winston Churchill’s secret arm of covert and clandestine operators known as the Special Operations Executive were so secretive even MI6 were unaware of who they were. Often solitary, the nature of their hidden operations, serving with resistance fighters, may have never had reports and few had recognition past confidential archives. The Intrepid X pays tribute to operatives of the SOE, their missions from 1940 – 1946 and the descendant Canadian intelligence and military organizations. We honour their stories, told or forgotten, by bringing to light the sacrifices they made for our free world. Each Watch is Numbered and Limited to 150 pieces (Across Black & Stainless Steel)!
